'''Fendu Tisk''' was a<ref name="RCAS" /> [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]]<ref name="Mini" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] student of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He stood 2.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and was skilled in dodging, [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]], and bargaining, and was knowledgeable about [[Alien/Legends|alien races]], [[Language/Legends|languages]], and medicine. He carried a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] and an alien memento.<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fendu Tisk was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Tisk's character type was listed as "Alien Student of the Force" and his model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
